point_semantics: Official loss/data_s/update_s are means over each 100-update logging block.
aggregation: Equal-weight seed mean and observed min/max; no confidence interval or smoothing.
throughput_semantics: 100 updates divided by adjacent W&B log timestamps, starting at update 200. Includes intervening logging/checkpoint delays and shared-host contention. Attempt throughput additionally includes initialization and final saving.
